findings.suggestion: Add a start event to define where the process begins.
Add an end event to properly terminate the process.

findings.message: Element "svc" (serviceTask) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "svc" (serviceTask) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.

findings.message: Element "g" (complexGateway) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "g" (complexGateway) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.
Name tasks using "Verb Object" form, e.g. "Verify Invoice", "Send Notification", "Approve Request".
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: Complex gateway "g" is not supported by any Camunda 8 version.
findings.suggestion: Model it with an element Camunda 8 executes.

findings.message: Must have at least one start event
findings.suggestion: Add a start event to the process.
